paper.title: Sparse Attention Routing for Long-Document Summarization

evidence.quote: In this paper we study whether a sparse routing layer can match full self-attention on long-document summarization under a fixed token budget.
Sparse routing reaches 27.8 BLEU at 156 ms latency on the synthetic benchmark, improving over a Window-512 baseline by 0.9 BLEU while reducing latency by 17%.
A limitation of this synthetic study is that no real dataset was used, so the numbers cannot be generalized beyond the page.
